Click this button, and the downloader saves the avatars of the users you follow as ICON icon files.

Icon files are saved in the `pixiv users` folder in the browser's download directory. The file name rule is `{username}_{user ID}_icon.ico`, for example: `柠檬静静静静_66477791_icon.ico`.

The maximum size of the icon files generated by the downloader is 256px.

?> How many users are crawled depends on the "How many pages to crawl" setting. Each page contains at most 24 users.
